features.quote: early_stop_on_abandon: stop once the agent calls give_up or emits explicit give-up language. Continuing past abandonment burns tokens for no signal.
features.justification_quote: Continuing past abandonment burns tokens for no signal.

features.quote: early_stop_on_repeat_loop (default 6 consecutive identical actions): a model stuck in a tight loop has already revealed the behavior; further turns are waste
per-turn online heuristics recorded during the loop (self_blame_score, is_repeat_action, declared_giveup)
features.justification_quote: drive early-stop, provide free metrics independent of the judge, and cross-check the judge
